reserves.name: Brazilian-real cash deposited in a Brazilian bank account

sources.label: Independent public accountant certification for wBRL - March 2026

reserveReview.rationale: The March 31, 2026 certification reconciles 719,448 outstanding wBRL across six chains and R$809,597.28 of collateral to a Brazilian bank statement, then certifies that all outstanding tokens are backed by Brazilian reais at a financial institution in Brazil. The engagement is expressly a certification, not an audit or review, and the bank and account terms are not disclosed. Write-time re-open 2026-07-28: independent CPA certification PDF for wBRL as of 2026-03-31 still certifies 100% local-currency bank-deposit collateral; Ripio local stablecoins page still lists the wFIAT products.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Independent public accountant certification of the wBRL collateral as of March 31, 2026
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No reserve asset class is unclassified; the Brazilian financial institution, account type, and withdrawal liquidity are undisclosed.
